title: Maintenance Data Analyst Jobs
description:
Join Entarian as a Maintenance Data Analyst! 

 Entarian is seeking a highly skilled Maintenance Data Analyst to support our meshONE-T program by analyzing maintenance data, identifying trends, and providing actionable insights. This position plays a critical role in optimizing maintenance processes, improving system reliability, and supporting decision-making through data-driven analysis. This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the design, implementation, and operation of the broader meshONE capability, supporting the United States Air Force, United States Space Force, and their mission partners. 

 If you thrive in dynamic settings and excel at balancing competing priorities, we invite you to be part of our innovative team. 

 Job Overview 

 As a Maintenance Data Analyst, you will: 
 Collect, clean, and analyze maintenance data to identify patterns and trends. Develop reports, dashboards, and visualizations to present findings to stakeholders. Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to maintenance effectiveness and efficiency. Collaborate with maintenance and operations teams to improve asset management and preventive maintenance strategies. Conduct root cause analysis of maintenance issues and recommend corrective actions. Support the development and implementation of predictive maintenance strategies. Ensure data integrity and accuracy in maintenance management systems. Assist in optimizing maintenance workflows and resource allocation based on data analysis. 
 Job Responsibilities 

 Data Collection & Analysis 
 Gather, clean, and preprocess maintenance-related data from various sources. Identify trends, anomalies, and insights within maintenance data to improve performance. 
 Reporting & Visualization 
 Create interactive dashboards and reports to communicate maintenance performance and trends. Present findings to leadership and stakeholders to support decision-making. 
 Collaboration & Process Improvement 
 Work closely with maintenance teams to refine maintenance strategies and operational processes. Identify opportunities for process automation and efficiency improvements. 
 Predictive & Preventive Maintenance Support 
 Develop models for predictive maintenance to anticipate equipment failures. Assist in implementing preventive maintenance measures to reduce downtime and increase asset lifespan. 
 Compliance & Data Integrity 
 Ensure data accuracy and compliance with industry regulations and organizational policies. Maintain and enhance data governance practices within maintenance management systems. 
 Compliance and Safety 
 Ensure all maintenance activities adhere to safety protocols and regulatory requirements. 
 Continuous Improvement 
 Gather feedback from stakeholders to enhance collaboration and effectiveness. Track and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to maintenance activities. 
 Position Details 
 Job Type: Full-Time, Monday through Friday. May require work outside regular business hours to address urgent priorities. Work Environment: In-office position directly supporting improvement and maintenance activities. Location: Colorado Springs, Colorado, Denver, Colorado, or El Segundo, California Travel: Some travel between locations in Colorado and California. Security Clearance: Top Secret/SCI Eligible.Salary Range: $110 - 120k 

Minimum Qualifications

 Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 5+ years of progressive experience in maintenance data analysis, operational data analysis, reliability, logistics, or a related field. Proficiency in data analysis tools such as Python, R, SQL, Excel, or similar technologies. Experience with maintenance management systems (CMMS, EAM, REMIS, or similar). Experience developing reports, dashboards, and data visualizations using tools such as Power BI or Tableau. Ability to translate data findings into actionable recommendations for operational and maintenance improvements. Familiarity with predictive maintenance methodologies, reliability engineering principles, and asset lifecycle management. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and customer-facing skills. 

Desired Qualifications

 Experience working in a maintenance, logistics, or operations environment. Knowledge of machine learning techniques for predictive maintenance. Understanding of reliability engineering principles. Experience with business intelligence (BI) tools such as Power BI or Tableau. Extensive knowledge of Department of Defense service activities and operations. Experience with working in new and with emerging technologies 

About Us

Compensation 
 Entarian considers several factors when extending an offer of employment, including the location, scope, and associated responsibilities of the specific position, as well as a candidate's work experience, education/training, and key skills. 

 Benefits 
 All full-time employees are eligible to participate in our flexible benefits package, which includes: 
 Medical, Rx, Dental, and Vision Insurance 401(k) retirement plan with company-matching 11 Paid Federal Government Holidays Paid Time Off (PTO) Basic Life & Supplemental Life Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts Short-Term & Long-Term Disability Employee assistance program (EAP) Tuition Reimbursement, Personal Development & Learning Opportunities Skills Development & Certifications Professional Membership Reimbursement Employee Referral Program Competitive compensation plan Discretionary variable incentive bonuses based on factors such as individual performance, business unit performance, and/or the company's performance 
 Formed through the strategic union of Sev1Tech and ERT, Entarian is a premier provider of mission-critical engineering and technology solutions. Founded on a legacy of excellence dating back to 1993, Entarian is a product of an evolved and fully diversified engineering and federal technology leader. From deep space to defense and civilian missions, Entarian delivers secure, mission-aligned digital solutions that drive national resilience and operational effectiveness. We don't just support modernization; we define it. 

 Join the Mission and Start your Career Journey: Apply Directly via our Careers Portal Connect, Referrals & Inquiries? Email the team: careers@entarian.com 

Entarian is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, or disability status.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
Reports To: VP of Information Technology; works day-to-day with Commercial leadership

Location: Broomfield, CO / Hybrid

Compensation: $95,000- $125,000 base + 10% annual bonus target based on EBITDA

Job Type: Full Time

Travel Requirements: 5%




 

About the Role

Lignetics makes consumable products, including heating pellets, animal bedding, and grilling pellets, where demand moves with weather, seasonality, and retailer inventory. As part of the IT team, you will build and maintain the commercial BI environment, analyze the signals that drive demand, and deliver the reporting and insight senior leadership uses to run the business. You will use modern analytics and AI tools to get there faster.




 

What You Will Do

• Build analysis and tools on point-of-sale, on-hand inventory, weather, and internal sales data that signal changes in demand by category, customer, and region.

• Surface those signals early (sell-through shifts, inventory build or depletion, weather departures from normal) so the forecast and commercial teams can act on them.

• Prepare and present regular sales performance reporting to senior leadership.

• Design, build, and maintain dashboards and automated reporting and alerts that reduce manual work.

• Integrate data from Salesforce, retailer portals, external sources, and acquired businesses into reliable BI sources.

• Own data integrity across BI sources: identify and troubleshoot discrepancies, trace them to root cause, resolve them with source-system owners, and put checks in place so they don't recur. Maintain consistent KPI definitions.

• Use AI tools to speed up analysis, coding, and reporting, and validate output before it reaches decision-makers.

• Partner with commercial and cross-functional teams on requirements and ad-hoc analysis.











Requirements
 

What You Bring

Required

• 3+ years in analytics, BI, or data science supporting sales, revenue, or demand planning, ideally in CPG, retail, agriculture, energy, or another seasonal or consumption-driven business.

• Strong SQL and Python or R, plus advanced Excel and Access.

• Applied statistics: regression, time series, and trend analysis.

• Hands-on experience with a visualization tool such as Tableau or Power BI.

• Demonstrated use of AI/LLM tools in real analytical work, with examples you can walk us through.

• Track record of diagnosing and fixing data quality issues across multiple source systems.

• Ability to explain analysis, and its limits, to non-technical executives in plain language.

• Ownership mindset: you take a messy question to a finished answer without being managed step by step.

Preferred

• Experience with retailer POS and inventory data (e.g., retailer portals, syndicated data).

• Experience analyzing weather- or seasonally-driven demand.

• Familiarity with Salesforce and ERP sales data.

• Experience with cloud data platforms and pipeline tools.

• Experience integrating data from acquisitions/disparate data sources.




What Success Looks Like

• 90 days: You know our data, categories, and customers; you have validated the core performance reporting and shipped your first automation.

• 6 months: Demand-signal analysis (POS, on-hand inventory, weather) is live for our major categories and feeding the forecast and pre-season planning cycle.

• 12 months: Demand shifts are flagged ahead of the forecast, manual reporting time is materially reduced, and leadership relies on your analysis for customer and inventory decisions.




Benefits

Annual Bonus Eligibility Employee referral bonus programPTO+ 2 floating holidaysMedical, Dental, and Vision Insurance (FSA & HSA options)Educational assistanceLife insurance, short term & long-term disability401(k) with employer match & immediate vestingEmployee heating pellet programLignetics SWAG gear to include an annual pair of work boots & other PPE #IDCorporate

title: Data Engineer
description:
Position Title: Data Engineer

Department: Information Technology

Reports to: Data Team Manager 

Compensation: $100,000 - $130,000

Hours: Full-time, Monday - Friday, 8:30am - 5:00pm, with flexibility as business and project needs require.

Benefits
• Three weeks of paid vacation
• Paid sick time
• Eight and a half paid holidays per year
• Two paid flexible holidays per year
• ICHRA Health Insurance Reimbursement
• 100% Employer Paid Dental and Vision Insurance
• 100% Employer Paid Life Insurance
• 100% Employer Paid Medical Clinic Membership or Cash Equivalent for employees and dependents
• Other benefits accrue over the first 3-24 months, including additional paid vacation, 401(k) with company matching, and quarterly profit share.


Place of Work: Corporate Headquarters - 1730 South Street, Redding CA, 96001


Company Overview


Maas Energy Works is the leading developer and operator of agricultural waste-to-energy systems in the United States. The Company designs, develops, constructs, and operates biogas renewable energy generation systems, primarily on dairy farms. Our projects include anaerobic digesters, biogas-powered electric generation, and renewable natural gas upgrading.



Position Description
We are hiring a Data Engineer to own the operational backbone of our data platform: SQL Servers, the pipelines that move data out of it, and the Microsoft Fabric data warehouse that feeds reporting, regulatory work, and internal applications. The data is high-frequency time-series and operational data from more than 100 projects, so reliability, completeness, and monitoring matter as much as building new things.
This is a hands-on role on a small team that is actively modernizing its platform. We want someone who learns new tools on their own initiative, takes ownership of production systems, and wants to grow with the platform.


Essential Responsibilities
 


• Administer the SQL Server environment in Azure: backups and restore testing, SQL Agent jobs, index and statistics maintenance, security and access, storage growth, and performance tuning.
• Monitor continuous data ingestion from 100+ projects and resolve gaps, delays, duplicates, and out-of-range values before they reach downstream reporting.
• Build, maintain, and troubleshoot pipelines that move data from staging and external REST APIs into the Fabric data warehouse.
• Maintain and extend the warehouse's dimensional models, data quality rules, and load performance.
• Build alerting for pipeline failures, data freshness, and completeness, and own the response when they fire.
• Contribute to the migration of remaining workloads from Azure Synapse to Microsoft Fabric.
• Support analysts and application developers who consume warehouse data through Power BI semantic models and internal applications.
• Write and maintain runbooks and technical documentation, and work in Git with code review and CI/CD deployment.


Required Qualifications
• 3+ years of professional experience with SQL Server and T-SQL, including set-based query design, stored procedures, execution-plan tuning, and indexing.
• Hands-on database administration in production: backup and recovery, SQL Agent, maintenance jobs, logins and role-based security, and capacity monitoring.
• Experience building and operating production ETL/ELT pipelines (Azure Data Factory, Synapse pipelines, Fabric Data Factory, or SSIS), including incremental loads, failure handling, and reruns.
• Working knowledge of dimensional modeling: facts, dimensions, grain, and slowly changing dimensions.
• Hands-on Microsoft Fabric experience: Warehouse and Lakehouse, Data Factory pipelines, Dataflow Gen2, notebooks, and capacity monitoring.
• Familiarity with Azure fundamentals: resource organization, networking basics, managed identities, and Key Vault.
• Experience implementing data quality checks, monitoring, or alerting production data.
• Proficiency with Git.
• A track record of learning new tools and platforms independently and applying them to real work.
• Python, and C# programming languages
• Spark framework


Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with Power BI semantic models
• Experience with high-volume time-series, IoT, or industrial operations data.
• Microsoft certification DP-600 (Fabric Analytics Engineer) or DP-700 (Fabric Data Engineer).
 


Other Duties
Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive list of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.


Physical Demand Requirements

Work Environment - Office Staff
This role operates primarily in a professional office environment and uses computers, cloud platforms, databases, development tools, and communication systems. Limited travel to company offices or project locations may be required.
Physical Demands - Office Staff
This is largely a sedentary role requiring extended computer work, regular communication, and the ability to manage multiple technical priorities. The position may occasionally require travel in vehicles or airplanes and access to company operating locations.

title: Data Analyst, Marketing
description:
TurboTenant is hiring a Data Analyst, Marketing with 0 - 3 years of experience. Based in United States - Denver, CO and with Hybrid ways of working. 
 
 Job description and responsibilities: 

We are looking for a passionate and inquisitive Marketing Data Analyst to join our Data Analytics team, with a strong focus on bridging the gap between the Data and Marketing teams. This role will support the Marketing team with reporting and ad hoc requests, while also playing a crucial role in the data management and organization responsibilities of the data team. We're seeking someone who can elevate our marketing analytics efforts and drive impactful, data-driven strategies.


As a Marketing Data Analyst at TurboTenant, you will:



Utilize comprehensive reporting tools, SQL, and GA4 to conduct ad-hoc analyses, monitor campaign performance, and create compelling visualizations. 
Support the Marketing team by delivering easy-to-digest data and actionable insights, empowering them to make informed, data-driven decisions.
Lead the management and integration of marketing data from various sources. 
Be responsible for ETL processes to bring new data into TurboTenant's data lake, ensuring that the Marketing department has access to comprehensive and accurate data from all essential sources.
Enjoy the freedom to conduct independent BI research, analyze data proactively, and identify areas for improvement. 
Have the autonomy to recognize problems or opportunities at an organizational level and take action to implement data-driven solutions that drive meaningful impact across the company.
Oversee the accuracy and organization of TurboTenant's data lake in collaboration with the Data Team. 
Automate and maintain data processes, integrate new data sources, and update Metabase reports to reflect product changes. 
Connect user behavior with data and create comprehensive visualizations for KPIs and overall business performance.

 
 
 Requirements and qualifications: To be successful in this role, you must have:



At least 2+ years in a Marketing Analytics role, with a strong background in analyzing and interpreting complex data.
The ability to write complex, highly-optimized SQL queries, experience with Athena/Presto or Postgres preferred.
Proficiency in Excel functions such as Index Match, Pivot Tables, SumIf, Vlookup, and If statements, along with the ability to produce clear and insightful graphs.
At least 1+ years of hands-on experience leveraging GA4 for insights and performance measurement.In-depth knowledge of key metrics like ROAS, ROI, CAC, CPSU, LTV, Churn Rates, CPA, CPC, CPM, and CAC Payback, and how they interrelate.
Experience using a data visualization platform (bonus points for Metabase) to create clear, impactful visual representations of data.
Deep experience working with complex attribution models to extract actionable insights that drive strategic decisions and optimize spend.
Experience with digital media platforms like Google Ads Campaign Manager, Facebook Ad Manager, and other digital tools.
Ability to effectively interpret data and present it in easy-to-understand visualizations that support decision-making.
A demonstrated ability to manage projects independently and work autonomously to meet goals.

Bonus points if you have:



Programming experience with Python or R.
Knowledge of AWS S3, Glue, and Athena for data storage and processing.
Familiarity with API integration and data ETL processes.
Understanding or experience with Halo Analysis.
Familiarity with GitHub or other code version control platforms.

TurboTenant has offices in Fort Collins and Denver, Colorado. Face-to-face time is an essential aspect of the TurboTenant culture, and the ideal candidate for this role would be expected in the Denver office once a week (more if preferred).

title: Consumer Insight Analyst
description:
Covetrus is hiring a Consumer Insight Analyst with 0 - 3 years of experience. Based in United States - Remote and with Remote ways of working. 
 
 Job description and responsibilities: 

Covetrus is looking for a Consumer Insight Analyst to provide complex, reliable, and timely analytics and quantitative insight to accelerate Covetrus' consumer-facing marketing, product experiences, and strategic business initiatives. You will support the strategic plan that improves new consumer acquisition, improves consumer retention, influences product and brand preference, and improves the experience of our consumer-facing products. You will conduct analytics and support the development of analytical frameworks that deepen the collective understanding of the business, consumers, and pet parents. You will contribute to a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement as you provide insight into the business and drivers of consumer behavior, loyalty, and product preferences.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


Support data-driven marketing and business decisions for the Prescription Management commercial teams by aggregating data from multiple sources (including the Practice Information Management System), applying predictive analytics and forecasting techniques, and delivering insights in a clear and actionable format.


Identify, develop, and execute analyses to support business decisions and uncover areas of opportunity to shape consumer experience, drive consumer adoption, increase consumer loyalty, and influence brand preference, and consumer engagement.


Maintain a thorough understanding of consumer behavior, competitive trends, and business drivers to inform decision making.


Analyze key trends and build models that predict consumer behavior using statistical rigor.


Establish scalable, efficient, automated processes for large-scale data analysis.


Partner with various teams supporting the prescription management business to design, develop, and maintain forecasts, analyses, reports, and dashboards on key drivers for the business.


Collaborate across the organization to solve critical business challenges and support business strategy. 


 
 
 Requirements and qualifications: QUALIFICATIONS:


EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE:


Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Business, Computer Science, or a related field.


2+ years of experience in data modeling, business analytics, or consumer insights, ideally in a digital or eCommerce setting.


COMPETENCIES (Skills and Abilities):


Proven expertise in forecasting and predictive modeling for business analytics (ideally using R and/or Python).


Proficiency in SQL and at least one other programming language (R, Python). Experience with Snowflake is preferred.


Ability to work with large-scale, complex datasets.


Experience in designing and building data infrastructure/automated reporting tools.


Demonstrated experience delivering actionable predictive insight for a consumer business.


Strong analytical and quantitative skills, including the ability to use customer research, hard data and metrics for business analytics and to test marketing effectiveness.


Experience conveying key insights from complex analyses in summarized business terms.


Understanding of how pricing, promotion, brand impressions influence consumer loyalty, brand preference, and lifetime value. 


Ability to synthesize insights and support other teams to drive action in various areas of the business and our consumer marketing activities.


Proven experience with Excel and working with databases.
